purpose: Five-seed long-form robustness evaluation using held-out validation artist/track style references and the V2 training duration/section vocabulary.

prompts.caption: Style inspired by the musical identity of YUAN / 徐梦圆 and the reference track "China-Future". Instrumental Chinese melodic EDM with adventurous and uplifting energy. A concise minor-pentatonic pipa hook is answered by airy dizi phrases and doubled by bright synth plucks. The arrangement builds gradually into a clear four-on-the-floor drop with wide synth chords, clean sub bass, crisp electronic drums and spacious fantasy ambience.

Style inspired by the musical identity of Xomu and the reference track "Mannenzakura". Instrumental melodic gaming progressive house with an optimistic and energetic mood. A short rising synth motif develops through varied endings and call-and-response phrases over clear chord movement. An atmospheric intro adds layers gradually before a bright four-on-the-floor drop with crisp drums, controlled sub bass, wide chords and a denser final return.

Style inspired by the musical identity of TheFatRat and the reference track "Time Lapse". Instrumental cinematic glitch-hop with playful suspense and a clear syncopated lead motif. Short glitched-synth phrases trade with restrained orchestral accents over punchy halftime drums and controlled sub bass. A sparse contrasting break interrupts the main groove before the motif returns with stronger layering, sharper micro-edits and wide cinematic space.
